key_facts.fact_en: The supply contract of 12 Jan 2026 (ready-mix concrete and precast elements) refers disputes to arbitration at the White Sail Commercial Arbitration Centre (clause 18)

The award was made unanimously by three arbitrators, seated in Dubai, in Arabic: AED 846,300 for unpaid supplies, 5% a year interest on it from 6 Apr 2026, AED 96,400 arbitration costs and AED 40,000 lawyer's fees; the respondent's counterclaim for late-delivery penalties was rejected
The award was served on the respondent on 15 Sep 2026 and no annulment action was brought within 30 days (ended 15 Oct 2026)
The application attaches the original award, a copy of the arbitration agreement and a copy of the record of the award's deposit with the court, as Article 55(1) requires
On 26 Oct 2026 the court ratified the award and ordered it enforced with the executory formula, finding no ground of annulment under Article 53 and no conflict with public order
A grievance against the order lies to the competent Court of Appeal within 30 days from the day after service of the order (Art. 57); the file does not say when the order was served
Execution file no. 752/2026 (commercial execution) was opened on 28 Oct 2026; this is known only from a handwritten note

reader_should_flag: The execution file number (752/2026, commercial execution) and its opening date (28 Oct 2026) on page 3 are handwritten only; neither appears in print.

One sentence on page 1 cites two laws: Article 52 is of the Arbitration Law (Federal Law No. 6 of 2018) and Article 212 is of the Civil Procedure Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 42 of 2022). Both citations are valid; Article 212 must not be read as an Arbitration Law article (that law's articles run only to 61).
